main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "For each test case, reads a W/non-W grid from stdin, derives all enabled 2x2 quadrant patterns, and prints the maximum value returned by the external compt function over every enabled pattern partition." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> argc </REF>: int "Unused command-line argument count."
        <REF> argv </REF>: char** "Unused command-line argument vector."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return </REF>: int "Returns 0 after all cases are processed."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Declare unsigned long integer variables no_cases and case_no. RESULT no_cases]
            [COMMAND Read one unsigned long integer from stdin into no_cases using scanf with format "%lu"; ignore the return value of scanf. RESULT no_cases]
            [COMMAND Start the outer loop with case_no = 0; while case_no != no_cases, run the loop body and then increment case_no by 1. RESULT case_no]
            [COMMAND Within the loop body, declare int r, c, x, y, s; declare int best initialized to 0; declare char grid[20][20]; declare char extras[6] initialized to all zeros; declare char quads[16] initialized to all zeros except quads[0] = 1 and quads[15] = 1. RESULT best]
            [COMMAND Read two integers from stdin into r and c using scanf with format "%i%i"; ignore the return value of scanf. RESULT r and c]
            [COMMAND For each row y from 0 while y != r, first consume characters from stdin until a newline is read, then read the next c characters as that row's grid values. RESULT grid]
            [COMMAND Within each row, for each column x from 0 while x != c, set grid[y][x] to 1 if the character read by getchar is 'W' else 0, and set extras[last << 1 | this] = 1 where this is the new cell value and last is the previous cell value (initialized to 2 for each row); then set last = this. RESULT extras]
            [COMMAND After finishing each row y, set temp[y][0] = 0 and temp[y][c+1] = 0 in the assumed external/global temp array. RESULT temp]
            [COMMAND After reading all rows, for each column x from 0 while x != c, set temp[0][x] = 0 and temp[r+1][x] = 0 in the assumed external/global temp array. RESULT temp]
            [COMMAND If extras[2] is set, OR 1 into quads[10]; if extras[1] is set, OR 1 into quads[5]. RESULT quads]
            [COMMAND For y from 1 while y != r and x from 1 while x != r, set quads[grid[y-1][x-1] << 3 | grid[y-1][x] << 2 | grid[y][x-1] << 1 | grid[y][x]] to 1. RESULT quads]
            [COMMAND For y from 1 while y != r and x from 0 while x != r, compute j = grid[y-1][x] << 2 | grid[y][x], then set quads[j << 1 | j] to 1. RESULT quads]
            [COMMAND For q from 0 while q != 16, if quads[q] is nonzero, iterate ydiv from 0 through r inclusive and xdiv from 0 through c inclusive. RESULT q]
            [COMMAND For each selected q, ydiv, and xdiv, for every y from 0 while y != r and x from 0 while x != c, set temp[y+1][x+1] to 1 if grid[y][x] equals the bit of q selected by ((y < ydiv) << 1 | (x < xdiv)); otherwise set it to 0. RESULT temp]
            [COMMAND Within the same q, ydiv, and xdiv loops, for every y from 0 while y != r and x from 0 while x != c, call the external compt(y + 1, x + 1), store the returned value in s, and set best = s if s > best. RESULT best]
            [COMMAND After the enumeration loops finish, print using printf format "Case #%lu: %i\n" with case_no + 1 and best. RESULT _]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from main. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
